decisionsTitle: A raffle with a sign-up of its own: «Cine poate participa», «Din oficiu» or «Cu înscriere separată», «Regulamentul tombolei», three doors, the elite list's lines, and «Ziua cursei» → «Tombolă» (amending §949 and §948)
decisionsSection:
**The owner, 2026-11-18, from a phone, three days before Saturday's race, in this order:** «Tot pentru ziua cursei vreau să am un tab de tombolă unde să văd toți participanții la tombolă» (for race day too, I want a raffle tab where I see everybody in the raffle) — «Dar pentru tombolă trebuie să am o înscriere separată» (but the raffle needs a sign-up of its own). Asked, the owner chose: in the sign-up mode only those who sign up are in; they sign up three ways — a tick on their own registration's page, a public form on the site, at the desk on race day —; and each accepts a «Regulamentul tombolei» approved by the club, without which the sign-up does not open. Then: «Practic oamenii trebuie să își treacă numărul de concurs și numele, dar trebuie să am și o bifă de "voluntar" dar asta cu tombolă trebuie să fie configurabilă» (people type their race number and their name, with a «volunteer» tick, and the raffle has to be configurable) — «Vreau să pot bifa asta: tombolă din oficiu vs tombolă cu înscriere separată» — «Și trebuie să bifez acolo cine se poate înscrie: doar alergătorii și elitele și voluntarii. Și vreau să văd în dreptul fiecărei persoane dacă participă la tombolă» (I tick who may sign up — runners, elites, volunteers — and I see beside each person whether they take part).

**What was there.** «Avem tombolă» (`events.has_raffle`, §949) showed the «Tombolă» column on the registrations and «Voluntari» lists; «Participă la tombolă» (`registrations.in_raffle`, `event_volunteers.in_raffle`, on by default) was the organizers' exclusion; «Lista pentru tombolă» (§948) and, since the decision of the same day that added «Prezent» on a volunteer, its present-only twin held every confirmed real registration and every confirmed volunteer with a number, not taken out. Everybody was in «din oficiu», nobody signed up, and a line of the race's elite list (§895 — a name, an optional number, not a registration) was in no file.

**What §949 refused, and why this answers it.** §949 refused «a separate sign-up link where a person types their race or volunteer number» for three reasons: a public form that takes a number anybody can type needs a way to know the typist is that number's person; a new text for the privacy notice; and one more thing for a runner to do on the day, for a list the desk already has. The owner now asks for it on his own word, and each reason has its answer: the number alone signs nobody up — the name typed must be the registered person's, folded, every word typed among the registered name's words and at least two of them, and a refusal says neither which half was wrong nor whether the number exists; the privacy notice gains its paragraph, and no door opens until the notice in force names it and the club's own rules are approved; and the sign-up is a mode the club chooses per event — «Din oficiu» stays the default, exactly the file it was.

**Decision.**

- **The settings, per event** (migration `0217`, expand only), under «Avem tombolă» in the editor's «Numere de concurs» — the event's save, the Administrator's (§542); one edition's own, like `has_raffle` (no series edit, copy or event file carries them); read by no public query but the gate's:
  - **«Cine poate participa la tombolă»**: «Alergătorii» (`events.raffle_runners`: confirmed real registrations with a race number, not marked «Elită» — an ambassador runs as a runner), «Elitele» (`raffle_elites`: registrations marked «Elită», §897, and the lines of the race's elite list), «Voluntarii» (`raffle_volunteers`: confirmed volunteers with a number). All three on by default; they decide in both modes.
  - **«Cum participă»**: «Din oficiu: toți cei bifați mai sus» or «Cu înscriere separată: doar cei care se înscriu» (`events.raffle_sign_up`, false by default — no event changes by itself).
  - **«Înscrierile la tombolă sunt deschise»** (`events.raffle_sign_up_open`, false by default): the organizers untick it at the draw.
- **An elite list's line takes part like a person**: `event_elite_entries.in_raffle` (on by default, the organizers' exclusion, as for a registration and a volunteer) and `present` (off by default; the desk checks no line in), both set on the «Tombolă» tab by `canTakeRaffleList`, audited `event_elite.in_raffle` / `out_of_raffle` / `present` / `absent` with the line's id, never its name. In the files a line is «Elită», its number when it has one and an empty number cell otherwise, the numberless lines after the numbered ones, by name; a registration marked «Elită» is «Elită» too. `RaffleKind` is RUNNER | ELITE | VOLUNTEER, «Alergător» / «Elită» / «Voluntar» in both catalogues.
- **«Regulamentul tombolei»**: a legal document key of its own, `RAFFLE_RULES`, added in its own expand-only migration `0216` (PostgreSQL cannot use an enum value in the transaction that adds it); a platform template in Romanian and English (`templates/raffle-rules.ts`, nine sections: the organiser; who may take part — the groups the event ticks; how to sign up — the three doors; the draw — among those signed up, at the event, at the announced time, the winner present; the prizes as the organizers announce them; how a winner is told and that no name is published online without the person's agreement; the data, pointing to the privacy notice; withdrawal; disputes), the club's four facts as visible `<PLACEHOLDER>`s and the event's as merge fields filled at the acceptance (`{{event}}`, `{{eventDate}}`, `{{eventLocation}}` and `{{raffleGroups}}`, the ticked groups in words). Approvable in `/admin/legal` like the volunteer agreement, its own group there; the seed's sample outside production under the not-approved banner (`yarn db:seed:legal` too), never in production. An acceptance keeps the version, the moment, the language, the SHA-256 of the exact text read with its blanks filled (§556's `signedTextHash`) and the blanks — as the volunteer agreement's (§758, §771) — and it is one more reliance on the version: `ON DELETE RESTRICT`, counted on the legal list.
- **The elites' public name.** The mark «Elită» is the organizers' own (§917: «e ceva intern — ei nu știu asta»): the rules, the notice and every word a participant reads call the group «sportivii de top ai cursei» / “the race's top athletes” (a line of the elite list «un sportiv de top fără număr»), and §917's guard holds it; the backoffice keeps «Elitele», and the editor's help says how the rules name them.
- **The notice**: the privacy notice template's section 5 gains the paragraph «Tombola ({{raffle}})» and section 7 its line — what a sign-up keeps (who the person is for the raffle, the name typed, whether a volunteer, the rules' acceptance and its trace or the staff member who recorded it, the notice's version), why, the basis (the taking part, art. 6(1)(b); the proof, art. 6(1)(f)), who sees it (the organizers and the administrators), for how long (thirty days after the event's start), no email, how to withdraw. The marker `{{raffle}}` is filled with the public form's own name, quoted (`raffle-words.ts#raffleClause`), and is the switch: `describesRaffle`, `noticeDescribesRaffle` (every language), the cached twin, the legal editor's legend in both languages. Nothing was approved by the platform; no approved text changed.
- **One gate**, pure (`volunteers/domain/raffle.ts#raffleSignUpClosedFor`), read by every door, page and action: a raffle; the sign-up mode; the sign-ups open; a published, scheduled race not ended (its end, else the next midnight after its start day on its own clock — the desk signs people up after the start); `RAFFLE_RULES` in force and the notice in force naming `{{raffle}}`, both in every language; and the person's group ticked. Shut, no door is drawn and every action refuses with `RAFFLE_SIGN_UP_CLOSED`, writing nothing.
- **The store**: `event_raffle_entries`, one row per person per event — exactly one of `registration_id`, `volunteer_id`, `elite_entry_id` (a CHECK; each `ON DELETE CASCADE`, the event's too; each unique) —, `method` LINK | FORM | DESK | STAFF, the rules' acceptance (`rules_document_id` RESTRICT, `rules_accepted_at`, `rules_locale`, `rules_text_hash`, `rules_facts`), `typed_name` (FORM only), `ip` / `user_agent` (LINK and FORM only), `recorded_by_staff_user_id` (DESK and STAFF only, `SET NULL`), the notice's version, `created_at` — each door held to its own columns by a CHECK. Deleted thirty days after the event's start by the maintenance sweep (`jobs/retention.ts`, step `event-raffle-entries`, the row's own age asked too) and with its person; «Toate datele unei persoane» lists it (art. 15); audited `event_raffle.entry_created` / `event_raffle.entry_withdrawn` with the door and the group (and who withdrew), never a name, a number or a typed word.
- **The doors**, open gate only:
  - **LINK** — a «Tombola» card on «Gestionează înscrierea» for a confirmed real registration with a number of a ticked group: the rules in a fold, «Am citit și accept Regulamentul tombolei», «Particip la tombolă»; once in, «Ești înscris la tombolă» and «Nu mai particip» (withdraws, audited). POST only, the token read and never spent; the house's rule for who acts on a link (§547, §421) — another adult on the address may be taken out from it, never signed up: their acceptance is their own.
  - **FORM** — the event's own page `/evenimente/<slug>/tombola` (`/en/events/<slug>/raffle`), linked from the event's page by one calm line and button while the gate is open (a members' event never): «Numărul de concurs» (digits), «Numele» (as at registration), «Sunt voluntar» (only while the volunteers may take part; the number is then the volunteer's), the rules in a fold with the acceptance's tick, the notice's line. The honeypot, the timing check, Turnstile while the Administrator's switch is on and its keys are set, and two throttles: the number at the event (five an hour, hashed) and the event (a thousand an hour) — never an IP (AGENTS.md §19.4). The server matches the number to a confirmed real registration of a ticked group (or, with «Sunt voluntar», a confirmed volunteer's number) whose name matches the typed one — both folded (case, diacritics, punctuation, spaces), every typed word among the registered name's, each once, at least two unless the registered name has one, in any order (`typedNameMatches`, a pure, table-tested matcher); a match records FORM with the typed name, the IP and browser and the notice's version; anything else is one neutral sentence; a person in already reads the same thank-you; no email. A 404 while the gate is shut, but for the thank-you of a person reading the answer to their own post on an event whose raffle asks a sign-up.
  - **DESK** — inside every row of the desk's list (where a search by name or number, or a typed code, lands; one read for the rows shown) and on the view of a scanned person: «Tombolă: participă / nu participă» and why, always, in both modes, to every desk role (`canWorkTheDesk`) — but the organizers' own exclusion, «scos de organizatori», only to the organizers (`canTakeRaffleList`), whose decision it is: every other desk role reads «Tombolă: nu participă» alone there, and every other reason as said («nu s-a înscris» is what lets the desk offer the sign-up); in the open sign-up mode «Înscrie la tombolă» with the tick «A acceptat regulamentul», the person having accepted the rules on paper or aloud, coming back where it was pressed (the list with its event and its search, or the view); the desk member is the recorder. Never offered for a person the organizers took out (the integration's review: the press answered «Gata: persoana e înscrisă la tombolă.» while the row kept saying «Tombolă: nu participă»): `raffle-roster.ts#raffleLineOf` asks `inRaffle` for the desk and a volunteer's page alike, and the «Tombolă» tab keeps its own offer, where the organizers read the reason beside it.
  - **STAFF** — on a volunteer's page and on the «Tombolă» tab, for the organizers (`canTakeRaffleList`): «Înscrie la tombolă», any of the three kinds of person — a line of the elite list's only door (it has no link and no printed number).
- **«Transformă în voluntar» and «Transformă în alergător»** (§948) move the person's sign-up with them, as they move the organizers' exclusion (§953): the same row, its door and its acceptance of the same rules for the same event, to the row the person becomes, in the transform's transaction, its id in the transform's own trail row (`raffleEntryId`) — else the cancelled row would keep it and a press about something else would drop a person who signed up. A registration the entry restarted that holds a sign-up already keeps its own; the other stays with its cancelled row until the sweep.
- **One function decides**, for both modes, whether a person takes part and why not — `in`, `groupNotAllowed`, `notConfirmed`, `noNumber`, `takenOut`, `notSignedUp`, in that order (`raffleParticipation`, unit-tested); the files (whole and present-only), the counts, the tab, the lists' columns, the person's pages and the desk all read it. «Din oficiu» with every group ticked is the file as it was, plus the elite list's lines; the organizers' exclusion is kept in both modes; presence is no condition, the present-only file is.
- **Beside each person**: the registrations list's and the «Voluntari» list's «Tombolă» column (one event chosen that holds a raffle) says «Da», or «Nu · <the reason in a few words>», under the organizers' tick, which stays — nothing for a test registration (§30), which takes part in no raffle and is never «neconfirmat»; a registration's page and a volunteer's page say it in one chip line, for the organizers; the desk says it inside every row of its list and on a scanned person's view.
- **«Ziua cursei» → «Tombolă»** (`/admin/checkin/tombola`, the event by `?eventId=` else the desk's default), for `canTakeRaffleList` — the Organizer and the Administrators (§949: «doar adminul și organizatorul pot bifa și vedea asta»), a 404 to everybody else —, drawn among the tabs only for an event that holds a raffle: the settings in one line (who, how, open or closed, and why closed when the settings alone would open it, with the way to the editor for who may save it), the counts (taking part by group, and how many of them were there), the filters «Toți» / «Participă» / «Nu participă» / «Doar prezenții» (each with its number), everybody of the three groups in one table — number, name, group, «Participă» Da/Nu with the reason, how and when they signed up (sign-up mode), «Prezent» — with the organizers' «Înscrie» (STAFF, sign-up mode, gate open), «Scoate» / «Pune înapoi» (the exclusion, through each kind's own writer), «Șterge înscrierea» (asked first; at any time — a correction, not a door) and an elite line's «Prezent»; the two downloads; printable without its controls. One small entry in `RaceDayTabs.tsx`, the fourth of the organizers' five with «Cronometrare» (the finish line's decision of the same day): «Prezența», «Clasament», «Cronometrare», «Tombolă», «Lucruri de adus». Five are wider than a phone, so the row is no longer a `fits` row (§974): it scrolls inside itself, every entry one sideways swipe away and the page never sideways, and it carries the scroller that brings the current entry into view (§731); below `sm` it draws its short words alone, no glyph (`compact`), so a desk role's row of three still fits whole.
- **`/admin/tasks`**: two rows, «Regulamentul tombolei» and «Nota de confidențialitate: înscrierea la tombolă», open while a raffle ahead is «Cu înscriere separată» and its text is not in force in every language, done by themselves the day it is; each with its «Cum» steps in both languages. `SETUP.md` § 47 is the club's procedure, «Din oficiu» its fallback: until both texts are in force a raffle «Cu înscriere separată» takes nobody — the gate is shut and nobody can sign up —, so the editor's help, the two rows and that procedure say to leave «Cum participă» at «Din oficiu» until then.

**Who.** An Administrator sets the event (the editor's save); the Organizer and the Administrators work the tab, sign people up there and on a volunteer's page, take people out and put them back, tick an elite line present and take the files; every desk role signs a person up at the desk; a person signs up themselves from their link or the public form. Each action asks its capability at the door and the service asks again (BR-REQ-060-01).

**What it does not do.** It tells nobody: no email at a sign-up, a withdrawal or a deletion, no public list, no count the public is given, no badge, no public cache expired (`tests/unit/volunteers/raffle-entries-never-leave.test.ts`). It moves no state, place, number or count of a registration or a volunteer, and neither the allocator nor the capacity formula reads it.

**Refused.**

- *An email per sign-up.* The person sees the answer on the page that took it; an email would be one more message in the outbox the race week needs for its links, for nothing the person does not already know.
- *A sign-up without the rules.* The owner's condition: no door opens until «Regulamentul tombolei» is in force, and every door asks its acceptance — the person's tick, or at the desk and by the organizers the person's word on paper or aloud, which the staff member's tick records.
- *The platform approving the rules.* Legal text is the club's (§29, §95): the platform ships the template and its sample, and only a version the club approved in `/admin/legal` has effect.
- *A throttle keyed on the visitor's IP address.* The house's rule (AGENTS.md §19.4): the key is what the action holds — the number at the event.
- *Falling back to «Din oficiu» by itself while a text waits.* Who takes part would change under the organizers' hands the day a text is approved or withdrawn; the mode stays theirs, and the screens say to leave «Din oficiu» until both texts are in force.
- *Saying which half was wrong.* A form that said «this number is not registered» or «the name does not match» would tell anybody which numbers exist and whose they are.

**Not done.** Drawing the winner on the site — the draw is the club's, at the event, from the file. A standing public page of the rules outside the form and the card. The Organizer closing the sign-ups from the tab (the settings are the editor's, the Administrator's save). An email or a public list of the entries, the timing page and the public results: out of scope.
changelogLine: - **A raffle with a sign-up of its own, and «Ziua cursei» → «Tombolă»** — under «Avem tombolă», «Cine poate participa» (the runners, the elites, the volunteers) and «Din oficiu» or «Cu înscriere separată»; in the sign-up mode a person signs up from their own registration's page, on the event's raffle form with their race number and name (or their volunteer number), or at the desk, accepting «Regulamentul tombolei» the club approves — no door opens before it and a notice describing it; the elite list's lines take part too; «Participă: Da/Nu» and why beside every person on the lists, the pages and the desk; and a «Tombolă» tab with everybody, the counts, the filters, the organizers' presses and the two files. Nobody is emailed. §NNN.

specsCriteria.text: Given an event that holds a raffle («Avem tombolă»), then its editor's «Numere de concurs» shows, under that tick, «Cine poate participa la tombolă» — «Alergătorii», «Elitele», «Voluntarii», each ticked by default (`events.raffle_runners`, `raffle_elites`, `raffle_volunteers`, not null, true by default) —, «Cum participă» — «Din oficiu» (the default) or «Cu înscriere separată» (`events.raffle_sign_up`, false by default) — and «Înscrierile la tombolă sunt deschise» (`events.raffle_sign_up_open`, false by default), each posted with its marker and saved by the event's save, the Administrator's (an Organizer's save is refused); a caller that did not post a box writes nothing for it; no series edit, copy or event file carries any of them; and the groups decide who takes part in both modes (2026-11-18, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given the legal document key `RAFFLE_RULES` («Regulamentul tombolei», its enum value added by a migration of its own), then the platform ships its template in Romanian and English — the organiser, who may take part, how to sign up, the draw, the prizes, the winners, the data, withdrawal and disputes — with the club's facts as visible `<PLACEHOLDER>`s and the event's as merge fields (`{{event}}`, `{{eventDate}}`, `{{eventLocation}}`, `{{raffleGroups}}`) filled at the acceptance, the race's elites named «sportivii de top ai cursei» / “the race's top athletes” and never by the internal mark; it is approved in `/admin/legal` like the volunteer agreement, seeded outside production as a sample under the not-approved banner and never in production; the privacy notice template names `{{raffle}}` in its section 5 and 7 paragraphs, filled with the public form's name; and no door of a raffle's sign-up opens until a `RAFFLE_RULES` version is in force and the notice in force names `{{raffle}}`, both in every language, the legal editor's legend naming both fields in both languages (2026-11-18, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given a raffle's sign-up, then one pure rule decides whether a sign-up may be taken — a raffle, «Cu înscriere separată», the sign-ups open, a published scheduled race not ended (its end, else the next midnight after its start day in its own zone), `RAFFLE_RULES` in force and the notice naming `{{raffle}}` in every language, and the person's group ticked — and while it is shut no door is drawn (the event page's link, the raffle's page — a 404 —, the manage card, the desk's and the organizers' «Înscrie») and every action refuses with nothing written; while it is open, the public form `/evenimente/<slug>/tombola` (`/en/events/<slug>/raffle`) takes a race number of digits and a name — and, with «Sunt voluntar», shown only while the volunteers may take part, a volunteer's number —, signs up only a confirmed real registration of a ticked group (or a confirmed volunteer) whose registered name holds every typed word, folded (case, diacritics, punctuation, spaces), at least two unless the name has one, answers anything else with one neutral sentence, a person in already with the same thank-you, keeps the honeypot, the timing check, Turnstile and a throttle on the number at the event and on the event, and emails nobody (2026-11-18, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given a confirmed real registration with a race number of a ticked group at an event whose raffle's sign-up is open, then its «Gestionează înscrierea» draws a «Tombola» card — the rules in force in the page's language, filled for the event, in a fold, the tick «Am citit și accept Regulamentul tombolei» and «Particip la tombolă»; once in, «Ești înscris la tombolă» and «Nu mai particip» —; both are POSTs that read the manage token and never spend it; the GET writes nothing; the press without the tick, or for a person the raffle does not take, writes nothing; a sign-up keeps the version, the moment, the language, the filled text's SHA-256, the blanks, the IP address and the browser; another adult on the address is offered only the way out — one not in is told only that they sign up from their own registration's page —; and no card is drawn where no rules can be read in the page's language (2026-11-18, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given the desk at an event that holds a raffle — every row of its list, where a search by name or number or a typed code lands, and the view of a scanned person —, then every desk role reads «Tombolă: participă» or «Tombolă: nu participă» with why, in both modes — the organizers' exclusion («scos de organizatori») said only to the Organizer, the Administrator and the Superadministrator, every other desk role reading «nu participă» alone there; a test registration has no line —, the list's rows from one read, and — «Cu înscriere separată», the sign-up open, the person eligible, not taken out by the organizers and not in — «Înscrie la tombolă» with the tick «A acceptat regulamentul», which records a DESK sign-up with the desk member as its recorder and no trace and comes back where it was pressed: the list with its event and its search, or the view; without the tick, or for a role that does not work the desk, nothing is written (2026-11-18, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Amends the raffle file's criteria. Given an event's raffle, then who takes part is one answer for both modes — the person's group ticked, confirmed (a registration also real), a number (a line of the race's elite list takes part by name), not taken out by the organizers and, «Cu înscriere separată», signed up — and «Lista pentru tombolă» and its present-only twin hold exactly those people, in four columns: the number (empty for an elite line without one, those lines after the numbered ones, by name), the name, «Alergător», «Elită» (a registration marked «Elită» and a line of the elite list) or «Voluntar», and «Prezent» (a line's own tick on the «Tombolă» tab); «Din oficiu» with every group ticked is the file as before plus the elite list's lines; and each download's audit row carries the three groups' counts, `onlyPresent` and `signUp`, never a name (2026-11-18, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given «Ziua cursei» → «Tombolă» (`/admin/checkin/tombola`), then it is drawn among the race day's tabs only for an event that holds a raffle and is a page only for the Organizer, the Administrator and the Superadministrator (`canTakeRaffleList`), a 404 to every other role; it shows the settings in one line, the counts by group and how many of them were there, the filters «Toți», «Participă», «Nu participă», «Doar prezenții», and everybody of the three groups — number, name, group, «Participă» Da/Nu with the reason, how and when they signed up, «Prezent» — with «Înscrie» (sign-up mode, gate open), «Scoate» / «Pune înapoi» through each kind's own writer, «Șterge înscrierea» (asked first, audited) and an elite line's «Prezent», each press asked again by the action and the service and audited without a name; and the registrations list's and the «Voluntari» list's «Tombolă» column says «Da» or «Nu» with the reason beside the organizers' tick, and nothing for a test registration (2026-11-18, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given a raffle sign-up (`event_raffle_entries`: exactly one of a registration, a volunteer or a line of the elite list, each cascading, unique per person), then it is in no email, on no public page or list, on no badge and in no public cache; it is listed in «Toate datele unei persoane» with its door, the rules' version, the name typed, the recorder's role and the trace; it goes with its person and its event and is deleted by the maintenance sweep thirty days after the event's start; and the trail names the door and the group, never a name (2026-11-18, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given «Ziua cursei»'s tabs with the organizers' «Tombolă», then «Tombolă» is the fourth of five — «Prezența», «Clasament», «Cronometrare», «Tombolă», «Lucruri de adus» —, the row scrolls inside itself and never the page, every entry scrolled to lies wholly inside the row, and the current entry is wholly inside it as drawn on a 320-pixel phone and on the desktop — the row brings it into view (2026-11-18, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Amends criterion 37 in what a transform carries. Given a person who signed up for the event's raffle, when an Administrator presses «Transformă în voluntar» or «Transformă în alergător», then the sign-up — the same row, its door and its acceptance — moves to the row the person becomes, in the transform's transaction, named by its id in `registration.became_volunteer` / `volunteer.became_runner`; a registration the entry restarted that holds a sign-up already keeps its own; and a press refused at any step moves nothing (2026-11-18, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

batchLine: a raffle with a sign-up of its own — «Regulamentul tombolei», the form, the link and the desk — and «Ziua cursei» → «Tombolă»
